messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1767004321 created — high latency alert for inference.prod.us-west-2: p95 spike ~1.8s, sustained for 7m. Auto-paging to oncall.

sasha (oncall): seeing the alert, joining. Can someone paste the dashboard link?

kai (sre): https://grafana.redwood/inference/d/latency?orgId=1&var-region=us-west-2 — tail shows sudden increase at 22:14 UTC, many queries hitting model-v2-large.

mike (eng-runtime): I see increased queue depth on the routing layer, backlog building at proxy->kvproxy. Suspect route affinity to model-v2-large due to recent rollout.

sasha (oncall): ack. First mitigation: temporarily route traffic to model-v2-medium for non-SLA customers, and reduce max batch size to 8 for all routes in us-west-2. Implementing now.

mike (eng-runtime): patching routing policy: setting route preference weight: model-v2-large=0.3, model-v2-medium=0.7 for us-west-2. Applying batch_size override: max_batch=8. Pushing now — logs: `PATCH /internal/routing 200`

kai (sre): seeing drop in queue depth. p95 down from ~1.8s to ~720ms after changes. Good signal.

elaine (support): starting draft status page + customer comms. Who owns the customer impact assessment?

taylor (eng-manager): I'll take the impact assessment. Quick summary: - Scope: US-West region only - Impact: elevated latency for a subset of gen requests between 22:14–22:36 UTC, best-effort fallback applied at 22:22 UTC, partial recovery by 22:28 UTC, full return to baseline by 22:38 UTC. No data loss, no failed requests above usual error rate.

elaine (support): draft status page blurb: "We experienced elevated inference latency in US-West from ~22:14–22:38 UTC. We rolled traffic to a smaller model variant and adjusted batching which restored normal latency. Some customers may have seen slower responses during this window. No request failures or data loss observed."

mike (eng-runtime): root cause note for postmortem: recent routing config change unintentionally increased affinity to v2-large for long-tailed sessions, combined with KV cache churn causing slower KV hits and longer backend execution. Need follow-ups: 1) revert rollout gating that bumped affinity, 2) add a safe-fallback policy to automatically route to smaller model under queue-surge, 3) telemetry to surface model-affinity shifts.

kai (sre): I'm creating an ops-todo: throttle candidate fallback + autoscaler tuning to avoid oscillation. Also schedule a canary test for routing changes in staging.

sasha (oncall): handing off to night oncall @mike — summary below. Please ack and follow incident runbook: 
- Incident: 1767004321 high p95 latency us-west-2
- Actions taken: traffic weighted to model-v2-medium, max_batch reduced to 8, KV cache warming policy triggered
- Current status: mitigated, monitoring for regressions
- Next steps: root cause analysis + postmortem (owner: mike)

mike (eng-runtime): ack. Taking ownership for RCA and postmortem. Will coordinate with runtime/release teams.

elaine (support): customer notification template (short): "We observed increased latency in US-West on <date/time window>. We applied fallback routing and batching changes which restored normal performance. We're investigating the root cause and will follow up with details and any corrective actions. If you saw a critical impact, reply here or contact support@redwood.com."

status-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATE DRAFT queued for review: "Service: Inference API (us-west-2) — Partial disruption — Elevated latency — Incident 1767004321 — Mitigated (22:38 UTC)."

kai (sre): metrics to attach to status update: p95 latency chart + request volume + queue depth pre/post mitigation — I'll export PNGs.

taylor (eng-manager): note for comms: avoid promising timeline for full RCA. Say 'we will share findings and a timeline for corrective fixes within 72 hours'.

sasha (oncall): quick note for runbook update: add automated fallback condition: if queue_depth > 500 for 2 minutes OR p95 > 1.2s for 3 minutes, route 60% traffic to next smaller compatible model and notify oncall.

mike (eng-runtime): adding that to the runbook now. Also will add a metric alert for model-affinity drift.

elaine (support): final: status page + customer email queued. If no objections, I'll publish both in ~10m.

taylor (eng-manager): no objections. Good job.

sasha (oncall): closing paging. If we see re-escalation, reopen channel. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT 1767004321 marked MITIGATED at 1767006599 (22:38 UTC).
